Other than these terms and conditions, bidder will be rejected if not submitting any document which is mentioned in the Bid document. 42) Specifications for Automated Cell Counter Technical Specifications of Automated Cell Counter 1. Automated cell counting and cell viability analysis system designed for high efficiency and accuracy in l aboratory settings 2. The system should support dual detection methods, including fluorescence & brightfield or digital hologr aphy 3. Instruments should be equipped with qualitative and quantitative measurements of cell viability and co unting (Live and Dead, and total cells). 4. Cell Size Detection Range: · Nominal Detectable Range: 1–70 µm or above · Optimal Range: 5–60 µm 5. System should have USB ports OR wireless connectivity (WiFi/Hotspot) which should allow to transfer a nd save the cell count data and image to an external computer for record keeping and printing purposes. 6. User-defined protocols or machine-learning-based classification should be provided. 7. The system must accommodate a sample volume range of 10–150 µL. 8. It should have minimum 5-megapixel camera with auto focusing & manual focusing features OR a digit al holographic sensor for proper use 9. The system shall be compatible with the following dyes: Trypan Blue, Acridine Orange, Propidium Iodide , Fluorescein Diacetate, etc, OR support staining-free (dye-free) viability measurements 10. Data Export Options: The system shall support data export in the following formats: Cell count and via bility data (CSV), Raw images (TIF), Analyzed images (annotated TIF), Full reports (PDF), Count and viability data, Cell images, Protocol used, Analytical histograms, Cluster maps. 11. The system should be provided with a compatible interface for documentation, visualization, and imag e processing.

12. The system must allow adjustment of the following parameters: Cell Size, Dilution Factor, Fluorescence Threshold, Live Cell Sensitivity, Noise Reduction and Roundness. 13. The system should be supplied with one unit of a compatible reusable slide and 50 units of compatible disposable cell counting slides OR an equivalent starter pack of 1000 or more disposable cartridges/slides). The manufacturer/OEM or authorized distributor shall ensure the continued availability of compatible reusa ble slides or disposable cartridges/slides, and other essential consumables/spares for a period of 5 years fr om the date of installation. 14. Copy of minimum three installation reports from Government institutes (for quoted models only) shoul d be submitted with the bidding documents 15. Service support should be locally, and complaints can be rectified within 48 hours 16. The system should be supplied with 3 years comprehensive onsite warranty. The bidder must also quo te separately for an additional 2 years of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) to be availed after the expiry of the warranty period. Other Terms and Conditions 1. Past Performance / Experience Certificate - The seller shall submit copies of Purchase Orders pertaining exclusively to the quoted make and model of fered in the bid. - Purchase Orders relating to any other make or model shall not be considered for evaluation. 3. Compliance Sheet for Technical Specifications - The seller shall submit a duly filled and signed compliance sheet on its official company letterhead agains t all the Buyer Added Bid specific ATC (Technical specifications) mentioned in the bid. - The compliance sheet shall clearly indicate the offered make and model against each technical specificati on, along with the corresponding compliance status (Complied / Not Complied). - The seller shall ensure that all technical specifications are addressed without omission. Automated cell counting and cell viability analysis system designed for high efficiency and accuracy in l aboratory settings 2. The system should support dual detection methods, including fluorescence & brightfield or digital hologr aphy 3. Instruments should be equipped with qualitative and quantitative measurements of cell viability and co unting (Live and Dead, and total cells). 4. Cell Size Detection Range: · Nominal Detectable Range: 1–70 µm or above · Optimal Range: 5–60 µm 5. System should have USB ports OR wireless connectivity (WiFi/Hotspot) which should allow to transfer a nd save the cell count data and image to an external computer for record keeping and printing purposes. 6. User-defined protocols or machine-learning-based classification should be provided. 7. The system must accommodate a sample volume range of 10–150 µL. 8. It should have minimum 5-megapixel camera with auto focusing & manual focusing features OR a digit al holographic sensor for proper use 9. The system shall be compatible with the following dyes: Trypan Blue, Acridine Orange, Propidium Iodide , Fluorescein Diacetate, etc, OR support staining-free (dye-free) viability measurements 10. Data Export Options: The system shall support data export in the following formats: Cell count and via bility data (CSV), Raw images (TIF), Analyzed images (annotated TIF), Full reports (PDF), Count and viability data, Cell images, Protocol used, Analytical histograms, Cluster maps. 11. The system should be provided with a compatible interface for documentation, visualization, and imag e processing.

12. The system must allow adjustment of the following parameters: Cell Size, Dilution Factor, Fluorescence Threshold, Live Cell Sensitivity, Noise Reduction and Roundness. 13. The system should be supplied with one unit of a compatible reusable slide and 50 units of compatible disposable cell counting slides OR an equivalent starter pack of 1000 or more disposable cartridges/slides). The manufacturer/OEM or authorized distributor shall ensure the continued availability of compatible reusa ble slides or disposable cartridges/slides, and other essential consumables/spares for a period of 5 years fr om the date of installation. 14.
